typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		F1 as string,
		F2 as string,
		F3 as string,
		F4 as string,
		F5 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(Calllist = substring(toString(F4), toInteger(1), toInteger(3)),
		JobName_NonUnicode = substring(toString(F4), toInteger(1), toInteger(50)),
		DispositionCode_NonUnicode = substring(toString(F5), toInteger(1), toInteger(50)),
		MemberNum_NonUnicode = substring(toString(F3), toInteger(1), toInteger(30)),
		Associate_NonUnicode = substring(toString(F1), toInteger(1), toInteger(50)),
		Market = $Market) ~> AddCallListandMarket
AddCallListandMarket split(isNull(F3) == true(),F3 == 'MbrKey', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(F3NotSet,HeaderRow,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(ScrubDate = toDate(toString(F2, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> ConvertScrubDate
ConvertScrubDate sink(input(
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MARKET as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE = ScrubDate,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNum_NonUnicode,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME = JobName_NonUnicode,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE = DispositionCode_NonUnicode,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MARKET = Market,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD = Calllist,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE = Associate_NonUnicode)) ~> OLEDBDestination
NonUnicodetoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> NonCalllistErrorFile
NonUnicodetoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> NonCalllistErrorFile
